Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · Clothes & getting dressed

style noun

fashion; elegance in dress and looks

also fashion, in style, out of style, stylish, elegance, go out of fashion, trend (fashion), trendy, the latest trend

classical

Liv. 34.4.12: aequātō omnium cultū

cultus, cultūs m.

noun, fourth declension

dress, style of dress, appearance

Other words

  • modus, modī m. — a style, a fashion

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 118, 167: style, modus; Traupman 160: novissimō modō

    novissimō modō, in the latest style (Traupman 160).

  • ēlegantia, ēlegantiae f. — elegance, good taste

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.5; Tac. Ann. 14.19 (Lewis & Short)

  • exolēscō, exolēscere, exolēvī, exolētum — go out of use; go out of fashion

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 118, 387: go out of style, exolēscō

Examples

  • sīc aequātō omnium cultū quid ūnaquaeque vestrum verētur nē in sē cōnspiciātur?

    if all of you dress alike, what is any one of you afraid will be noticed in her?Liv. 34.4.12

See also style, clothes, trend.
